course.title: Product Design -II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A cold finished shaft (fig. 4), AISI 1141 is to transmit power that varies from 200 to 100 hp and bck to 200 hp in each revolution at a speed of 600 rpm. The power is received by a 20-in. spur gear A and delivered by a 10-in. spur gear C. The tangential forces have each been converted into a force (A and C shown) and a couple (not shown). The radial component R of the tooth load is to be ignored in the initial design. Let $\Nu = 2$ , and considering varying stresses with the maximum shear theory, compute the shaft diameter.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
